verdict.rationale: BugSnag's own docs describe BugSnag On-premise as a self-hosted version of the product for organizations that want to manage their own data, deployable in existing PCI or HIPAA compliant environments. That directly delivers self-hosting of the core product, though the evidence is a single high-level doc statement. The 'Self Hosted MCP Server' item is about MCP tooling, not the core product, so it is not credited. missing for 10: installation/deployment documentation details, feature parity and licensing/plan requirements for on-premise, independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosted deployments.
